items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I just came off the road with Lil Armstrong, man.

ctx.x: I told my wife that Chick wanted me to go on the road. (Inaudible) talked to Chick. He say, "Hey, got any money?" I say, "Yeah, I got some money."
"I just came off the road with Lil Armstrong, man. (Inaudible) Charlie (inaudible)."
"Give me thirty-six dollars." This for joining (inaudible) Chick's band. Thirty-six dollars!
